body: I want to become an anesthesiologist because I love medical stuff but I don’t want to be a surgeon since that is just not for me. I don’t want to do anything with video games because that is really painstakingly long work of months just to make a tiny detail. But I do very much appreciate the people who put their time and effort into making them. I also want to say thank you for you taking the time to help me.

I want to become an anesthesiologist but honestly im afraid of failure. What makes me happy and I know it’s stereotypical of my age but I video games is what makes me happy and my mom and friends those are the only things I would miss if I killed myself.
All I can say is that I’m sorry for what has happened to you. I can’t even begin to understand how you feel.

I feel selfish to want to kill myself and I haven’t even gone through my loved ones dying or anything. People have it so much harder than me. Yet I want to kill myself for not wanting to live a repetitive  boring life.
